title: There are no Texas tenors
summary: He rejects the Texas tenor label; Buddy Tate copied Herschel Evans and Illinois Jaquet has a lot of Lester Young.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: What do you think about the whole idea of -- they're always talking about the Texas tenors.
And yet those guys had a certain thing where Herschel Evans, of course, came from Hawk, but he had his own --
And then it seemed like guys like Buddy Tate and Jaquet and that kind of came from Herschel.
Buddy copied Herschel, because Buddy took Herschel's place in Basie's band. And Illinois Jaquet has got a lot of Lester Young in him.
